headline: Brightline Systems publishes annual sustainability report
body: Brightline Systems released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Brightline Systems to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Brightline Systems will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Pune. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Brightline Systems faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Brightline Systems. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Brightline Systems signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Brightline Systems announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Brightline Systems wins quality award from industry association
body: Brightline Systems received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Brightline Systems reports minor shipment delays at Pune plant
body: Brightline Systems confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Pune plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.
